title: post api v1 security auth login with valid credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with valid admin/admin credentials returns 200 with a valid access token and refresh token.

title: post api v1 security auth login with invalid credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with a wrong password returns 401 Unauthorized and does not leak whether the username exists.

title: post api v1 security auth refresh with valid refresh token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/security/auth/refresh with a valid refresh token returns 200 with a new access token, and that a reused/rotated old refresh token is rejected.

title: post api v1 security auth logout requires authentication
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/security/auth/logout without a bearer token returns 401, and with a valid bearer token returns 204 and invalidates the refresh token.

title: post api v1 security auth forgot password neutral response
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/security/auth/forgot-password returns the same neutral 202 response for both an existing and a non-existing email, to prevent account enumeration.

title: access protected endpoint without token returns 401
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/security/me/modules without an Authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized, confirming the JWT filter protects non-public endpoints.

title: get api v1 security me modules with bearer token
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/security/me/modules with a valid bearer token returns 200 with the current user's granted dashboard modules.

title: post api v1 security users create requires permission
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/security/users with a token lacking PERM_SEC_USERS_CREATE returns 403 Forbidden, and with an authorized admin token returns 201 with the created user.

title: post api v1 security roles crud and permission assignment
description: Verify creating a role via POST /api/v1/security/roles returns 201, then granting a Tier-2 permission via POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions returns 200/204 and GET /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions reflects the grant.

title: delete api v1 security roles deactivate soft delete
description: Verify that DELETE /api/v1/security/roles/{id} performs a soft deactivation (204), and the role no longer appears as active on subsequent GET/search.

title: get api v1 security permissions list
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/security/permissions with valid query params (page, size) returns 200 with a paginated list, and requires PERM_SEC_ROLES_VIEW.

title: post api v1 security modules create and search
description: Verify POST /api/v1/security/modules creates a Tier-1 module (201), and POST /api/v1/security/modules/search returns it in results.

title: post api v1 common configurations crud lifecycle
description: Verify POST /api/v1/common/configurations creates a config (201), GET /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} retrieves it (200), PUT updates its value (200), and DELETE deactivates it (204).

title: post api v1 common configurations without auth returns 401
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/common/configurations without a bearer token returns 401 Unauthorized.

title: post api v1 common configurations duplicate key conflict
description: Verify that creating a configuration with a key that already exists returns a validation/conflict error rather than a duplicate silently succeeding.

title: post api v1 files categories create and search
description: Verify POST /api/v1/files/categories creates a file category (201) and POST /api/v1/files/categories/search returns it.

title: post api v1 files upload get metadata and access token flow
description: Verify POST /api/v1/files (multipart) uploads a file (201), GET /api/v1/files/{id} returns its metadata (200), POST /api/v1/files/{id}/access-token issues a token, and GET /api/v1/files/download?token= returns the file bytes (200).

title: get api v1 files download with invalid or expired token returns error
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/files/download with a missing, invalid, or expired token returns 401/404 rather than leaking file bytes.

title: delete api v1 files archive and delete actions
description: Verify DELETE /api/v1/files/{id}?action=ARCHIVE requires PERM_FILE_BROWSER_UPDATE and DELETE /api/v1/files/{id}?action=DELETE requires PERM_FILE_BROWSER_DELETE, each returning 204 on success and 403 when the caller lacks the specific authority.

title: post api v1 notifications dispatch success
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with valid authentication, valid channelHint, and active recipient returns 200 with dispatch accepted and creates per-channel logs. Then verify GET /api/v1/notifications/logs/{id} returns 200 with correct delivery statuses such as SENT or PENDING.
